title: linum ucranicum
intro: Linum ucranicum, commonly known as Flaxseed or Linseed, is a plant-based dietary supplement derived from the seeds of the Linum usitatissimum plant, primarily cultivated for its oil-rich seeds. The health benefits of Linum ucranicum include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive health due to its high content of omega-3 fatty acids and dietary fiber. The therapeutic actions of Linum ucranicum include its use as a demulcent, to soothe and protect mucous membranes, and as a laxative, to aid in bowel movements. The bioactive constituents of Linum ucranicum include alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), linoleic acid, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
